chrome.name: Chrome
chrome.pinHint: Chrome hides new extensions behind the puzzle-piece icon in the toolbar. Click it, then the pin beside PageShotter, to keep the button where you can reach it.
chrome.fileAccessRemedy: Open chrome://extensions, click Details on PageShotter, and turn on "Allow access to file URLs".

edge.name: Edge
edge.pinHint: Edge hides new extensions behind the puzzle-piece icon in the toolbar. Click it, then the eye icon beside PageShotter, to keep the button where you can reach it.
edge.fileAccessRemedy: Open edge://extensions, click Details on PageShotter, and turn on "Allow access to file URLs".

firefox.name: Firefox
firefox.pinHint: Firefox keeps new extensions behind the puzzle-piece icon in the toolbar. Click it, then the gear beside PageShotter, and choose Pin to Toolbar to keep the button where you can reach it.
